body:
## Reproduction steps

1. Launch Handrail on the iPad Pro 13-inch (M5) iOS Simulator 26.4.1 with an existing paired machine pointed at the local Handrail server on port 8788.
2. Open the iPad Dashboard.
3. Read the paired machine card under the machine name.

## Expected behavior

The paired machine address should render the host and literal port string without locale number grouping, for example `127.0.0.1:8788`.

## Observed behavior

The Dashboard machine card renders the port with a thousands separator: `127.0.0.1:8,788`.

This makes the local server address look like a different endpoint and conflicts with the local-first pairing evidence users need to inspect.

## Affected surface

- iPad Dashboard paired-machine card
- Observed on iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), iOS Simulator 26.4.1, UDID `43913CAF-14DD-45B6-9633-0A9790474FC7`

## Evidence

- Screenshot: `test-artifacts/qa-daily-simulator-sweep-2026-05-03-120259/mcp-screenshots/ipad-01-dashboard-paired-port-grouping.jpg`
- Run notes: `test-artifacts/qa-daily-simulator-sweep-2026-05-03-120259/notes.md`
- Shell `simctl` blocker log: `test-artifacts/qa-daily-simulator-sweep-2026-05-03-120259/logs/simctl-list-devices.txt`

## Verification needed

Re-run the iPad Dashboard paired-machine path and confirm the same machine renders as `127.0.0.1:8788` with no comma in the port.
title: iPad Dashboard formats local server port with thousands separator
